purpose: distinguish E-admissible/R-cheaper startup states from E-cheaper startup states using actual reusable Krylov prefixes without periodic method review
startup_state_machine: safety pass -> one bounded E Arnoldi and R GMRES prefix bake-off
conservative E cost advantage >= 15% -> E-K profile
E-K local inadmissibility -> immediate protected R-JF fallback

fixed_rules.proper_homotopy: deferred unless both primary methods are pathological

calibration: G4-S1 complex Dahlquist, quadratic, linear-to-nonlinear blend
holdout: G4-S1 advection-diffusion, oscillatory PR, nonlinear-to-linear blend
kill_rule: If actual startup prefixes cannot route quadratic-like states to R-JF without losing E-friendly states, stop automatic switching research; expose robust-R-JF and fast-E-K user profiles and retain R-JF as the generic default.
after_pass_only: forced-switch fifth-order recovery and controller-state transfer
